confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.issue: Native range input can fire before focus. The cancellation snapshot therefore captures the changed pointer value instead of the original field value.
confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.proof: final09 range-19 actual pointer events, per-step screenshots, SVG dimensions, downloaded payloads, video and Chrome timeline
confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.status: Fixed; actual source10 subset retest PASS
confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.fix: Capture original control values on pointerdown before the browser native range action; focus cannot overwrite that snapshot.

confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.issue: After Escape, the same held native range drag can still emit trusted input events and recreate a draft.
confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.proof: final10 trailing-22: no held-drag download probe; actual Escape restores original field and canvas, then six pointer moves without a new pointerdown issue trusted values 0.75/1.25 and change the actual canvas.
confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.persistenceAfterTrailingMotion: Not assessed in this failing attempt: the strict assertion stopped before mouseup.
confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.status: Fixed and actually retested in source11; narrow and Carbon full37 PASS
confirmedAndFixedProductIssues.fix: Suppress native range events belonging to the same cancelled gesture until its terminal event; permit a fresh gesture.

qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.finding: Cold local metadata migration completed during the original display test. The sole exact project difference was statisticalRenders added; source panels, table, recipe, analysis and variant SVG were unchanged.
qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.correction: Wait at most 30s for the real successful view-specific reflow, then at most 5s for an actual saved payload containing its cache; retain exact project equality for all editing operations. Do not interpret migration time as editing latency.
qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.additionalHarnessAttempt: The raw input initialState also gains the existing default labelNumbering:upper during opening. Compare the first actual opened project to the post-migration project, while requiring all original source panels to remain exact.

qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.finding: SVG namespace IDs also occur inside known statistical metadata JSON, beyond ID attributes. Actual valid/invalid SVGs differ only in generated identifiers.
qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.correction: Normalize only references to actual existing IDs within known metadata contracts; no numeric, text, style or geometry normalization. Retain raw SVG snapshots and hashes.

windowScreenshotComparison.scope: Actual window compositor screenshots; exact source SVG/style/geometry is asserted separately, with no pixel-tolerance substitution

qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.actualRetest: fresh05 metadata-12 P24 PASS; raw SVG snapshots use their original unique IDs in separate real Chrome SVG decoder/canvas rasters

qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.finding: Switching between two valid fields legitimately commits blur-bound edits. The strengthened draft test initially used a baseline before that setup.
qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.correction: Complete and record the explicit engineering calibration first, then preview one thickness field, check zero draft writes, Enter once, Undo/Redo and actual export.

qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.finding: The initial panel/content click did not establish actual image element selection. The retained initial attempt failed its expected history assertion.
qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.correction: Use actual panel navigation and its matching image layer name, then require element scope before calibration edits.
qaAndLegacyLoadFindings.actualRetest: fresh07 calibration-16 P37 PASS; each image independently keeps its declared calibration; selection writes no history; Undo removes only the second image calibration and restores unknown; Redo restores that calibration.

scientificLimits: The 100/20 micrometre calibration is an explicit engineering assumption used to validate geometry. It is not evidence of the specimen physical size.
Public CDC TEM is an officially digitally colorized low-resolution derivative, not acquisition raw data. Uncalibrated ROI scale remains disabled.
Computed comparison and bar-width fixtures are explicitly synthetic, generated with existing production scientific renderers. No biological inference or image-matching accuracy claim is made.
No private patient image or private measurement was used in these P1 runs. Remote browser requests were blocked and none were observed.
